answer: Verified Delay Ledger.** Each identity must pre-commit a zephyr of idle wait: its first N actions are time-locked, and its replies carry proof they were composed after a minimum quiet interval, checked against a shared grove of timestamped epochs. Fast, scripted bursts fail verification. An attacker running many identities pays the umber cost in parallel idle capacity—each sock puppet consumes real waiting time that cannot be multiplexed, so scaling to k identities costs k× the sustained attention budget.
